name: Arn
description: A young slave of Nazir who joins Lorris and Aylith's cause.

description_citations.text: "The Cursed Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebellion erupts; Nazir runs Aylith through with Soulslayer and Feryar carries her away.
timeline.quote: She tries to form a protective wall with her magic but the enraged Felonarch runs her through with Soulslayer—right above the heart.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "Flight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lorris aids Aylith and Jedhian's escape and steals a boat with Arn to pursue Nazir.
timeline.quote: She aided Aylith and Jedhian in their escape

citation.text: "Lorris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arn is captured in a raid and taken to Inys Nohr as the Felonarch's page; Nazir injures his shoulder.
timeline.storyline: Magic: The Gathering - Wilds of Eldraine / Cridhe (Keeper novel)
timeline.quote: He was captured in the spring raid around 3561 AR and taken to Inys Nohr to serve as the Felonarch's page.

citation.text: "Arn", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aylith heals Arn's shoulder; Arn helps Jedhian and Lorris escape by boat down the River Sobus.
timeline.storyline: Magic: The Gathering - Wilds of Eldraine / Cridhe (Keeper novel)
timeline.quote: the three fugitives stole a boat and fled down the River Sobus

citation.text: "Arn", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arn resolves to seek an alliance with the Far Clans and pleads for their aid.
timeline.storyline: Magic: The Gathering - Wilds of Eldraine / Cridhe (Keeper novel)
timeline.quote: He resolved to seek an alliance with the Far clans

citation.text: "Arn", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Morkin misleads Arn into an icy marsh; Feryar rescues him, and he succeeds in allying the clans.
timeline.storyline: Magic: The Gathering - Wilds of Eldraine / Cridhe (Keeper novel)
timeline.quote: Arn was rescued at the last moment by Feryar, who guided him back to safety.

citation.text: "Arn", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arn becomes Keeper of the new Clan Tree and settles in Inys Haen.
timeline.storyline: Magic: The Gathering - Wilds of Eldraine / Cridhe (Keeper novel)
timeline.quote: Arn took the mantle of the Keeper upon himself.

citation.text: "Arn", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feryar saves Arn from death in the icy marshes, ensuring the Far Clans could unite against Nazir.
timeline.quote: He also intervened to save Arn from death in the icy marshes

citation.text: "Feryar", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arn became the new Keeper as the Clan Tree grew for 1000 years.
timeline.quote: With the freed slave Arn as its new Keeper

citation.text: "Inys Haen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedhian, Lorris and Arn orchestrate a flight from Inys Nohr amid a growing rebellion.
timeline.quote: Jedhian helped orchestrate a desperate flight from Inys Nohr amid a growing rebellion

citation.text: "Jedhian", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arn, betrayed and left to die, is rescued by Feryar and brings the Far Clans into battle at the spring equinox.
timeline.quote: he returned just in time to bring the clans into the battle

citation.text: "Mending of the Clan Tree", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
